lfs.menu.checking: Checking whether Git LFS is installed…
lfs.menu.not_installed: Git LFS isn't installed. See Preferences > Git LFS.
lfs.page.checkout.tip: Replace pointer files in the working tree with contents already in the local store. Nothing is downloaded.
lfs.page.commands.label: Commands
lfs.page.fetch.tip: Download the LFS files the checked-out commit needs into the local LFS store. The working tree is not changed.
lfs.page.foreign_hooks.warn: These hooks already exist and aren't Git LFS hooks: {hooks}. Setting up will stop without changing them; merge them by hand (git lfs update --manual explains how).
lfs.page.gitattributes.help: Created when you track the first pattern.
lfs.page.held.body: Paused until you trust this repository.
lfs.page.held.help: Glowfly reads the LFS setup with Git, and Git would run the programs this repository's own settings and hooks name. LFS commands wait for your decision too.
lfs.page.initialize.help: Initialize LFS to work with these files.
lfs.page.missing.help: Install it from git-lfs.com, then choose Check again.
lfs.page.missing.patterns.warn.one: This repository stores {count} pattern in LFS. Without Git LFS, those files are checked out as small pointer files, and changing and committing them can break them for everyone.
lfs.page.missing.patterns.warn.other: This repository stores {count} patterns in LFS. Without Git LFS, those files are checked out as small pointer files, and changing and committing them can break them for everyone.
lfs.page.missing.warn: Git LFS isn't installed, so Glowfly can't run LFS commands here.
lfs.page.new_pattern.label: New pattern
lfs.page.no_repo.help: Open a repository to set up Git LFS.
lfs.page.not_set_up.body: Git LFS isn't set up in {repo}.
lfs.page.not_set_up.help: Setting up installs the LFS hooks and filters for this repository only (git lfs install --local). Without the pre-push hook, pushes don't upload LFS files.
lfs.page.patterns.help: Files that match a pattern are stored in LFS from their next commit. Files already committed stay in history as they are.
lfs.page.patterns.label: Tracked patterns
lfs.page.prune.tip: Delete old local LFS files that recent commits don't use and the remote already has.
lfs.page.pull.tip: Fetch, then replace pointer files in the working tree with their contents.
lfs.page.push.any_remote.tip: Upload every LFS file that local branches use to the remote.
lfs.page.push.tip: Upload every LFS file that local branches use to {remote}.
lfs.page.read_from_files: Read from the repository's attributes files.
lfs.page.source.info.tip: Set in .git/info/attributes, which only this copy of the repository uses and which isn't committed. To stop tracking it, edit that file.
lfs.page.source.nested.tip: Set in {file}, so it applies only inside {folder}/. To stop tracking it, edit that file.
lfs.page.status.label: Status
lfs.pattern.control: Patterns can't contain line breaks or control characters.
lfs.pattern.folder: A pattern ending in / matches nothing in .gitattributes. To track a folder, use {pattern}**.
lfs.pattern.git_file: Git's own files (.gitattributes, .gitignore, .lfsconfig) can't be stored in LFS.
lfs.pattern.negated: Patterns starting with ! aren't allowed in .gitattributes.
